RunGranted.description:
A runner made a run grant: a token that signs a cloud run in at the diocese's gateway. The token
itself never reaches the log. Published by a runner as a cloud run starts, or by
`priory gateway grant`.

hash.description: The token's SHA-256, in lowercase hex.

run.description: The cloud run's id on its runner; none on a grant made by hand.

runner.description:
The runner that made the grant and applies its calls; none on a grant made by hand, and on
a factory with no runner files.

seconds.description: How long the grant lasts, in seconds from when the log took this message.

task.description: The key of the task whose cloud run the grant signs in; none on a grant made by hand.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.
